blocks.text: On August 27, 2026, the Malankara Syrian Christian Association elected our beloved Vicar, Rev. Fr. Shibu Venad Mathai, as one of four new Metropolitans of the Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church. For the parish he has shepherded for fifteen years, it is a moment of profound joy and gratitude to God — and of bittersweet farewell.

blocks.title: Milestones Under His Leadership
items: June 2011 — Appointed Vicar of St. Gregorios Malankara Orthodox Church
2011 — Parish hosts the Metropolitan Enthronement of H.G. Zachariah Mar Nicholovos
2016, 2017 & 2019 — Bensalem Unity 5K organized by the parish
Since 2018 — Parish hosts annual Unity Week prayer fellowship
September 23, 2018 — Cemetery monument to our Patron Saint dedicated at Rosedale
2024 — Men's Forum founded, later renamed St. Joseph's Forum

blocks.text: Brothers in Christ, Serving Our Parish

Originally established in 2024 as the SGMOC Men's Forum, the organization was formally renamed to honor St. Joseph — a timeless pillar of quiet strength, humility, and obedience. Throughout 2025 and 2026, our members have actively immersed themselves in the sacramental life and service of the church, providing volunteer support for the Jubilee Celebrations, the annual Church Picnic, Parish Day, the Volleyball Tournament, the Harvest Festival, the Parish Perunnal, and Christmas programs.

blocks.title: Activities & Spiritual Growth
blocks.text:
Sunday meetings and seminars. Monthly meetings follow the Holy Qurbana and fellowship lunch. Sessions have included a Family Communication Series (Rev. Fr. Shibu V. Mathai and Mrs. Ceena Mathew), Cyber Security Awareness (Reji Ninan, Sumod Abraham, Saji Thomas), an Introduction to Artificial Intelligence (Sumod Abraham, James Varghese, Alisha Maret), and Finance, Investment and Retirement Planning (Biju Mani, Reji Ninan, Saji Thomas, Joseph Abraham).

Honoring our members. On November 16, 2025, the Forum celebrated Rev. Fr. K. P. Varghese on the 50th anniversary of his Holy Priesthood. On December 21, 2025, we celebrated the 90th birthday of our most senior member, Mr. Kuruvilla Kallelil. On March 22, 2026, the Forum honored Mr. Varkey Vattakkattu and Mrs. Mercy Varkey upon their relocation to Dallas, Texas.

Care and Share Ministry. Coordinated by John Kappil and Paul Maret, this ministry arranges home visits to parish members unable to attend services due to illness or age.

Fellowship and recreation. Annual urban hiking trips to New York City in 2025 and 2026 (coordinated by Biju Chacko and Mathew Joseph), a summer social gathering of over 30 members on August 23, 2025 (Nithin Ipe and Shiju Poovathoor), and performances at the Ecumenical and SGMOC Christmas programs.
